response: {"items":[{"type":"preference","content":"Member preferred a calm, step-by-step approach and asked for simple explanations when moving statements to paperless, as they were juggling the call with childcare."},{"type":"fact","content":"Paperless consent has been set for the member's card account, but they still want the next statement checked to make sure it arrives online only."},{"type":"observation","content":"The member was happy to verify their identity but needed a little extra time between questions, likely because they were dealing with children in the background."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member responded best to short, clear prompts and appreciated being told exactly where to tap or click to finish the paperless switch."},{"type":"fact","content":"An email address was confirmed for paperless updates, and the next adviser should check that no postal statements are still queued before closing the request."},{"type":"observation","content":"The member sounded distracted and asked for the information to be repeated once, so a slower pace and a recap at the end would help next time."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member preferred evening contact if a follow-up is needed, as daytime calls can be interrupted by school run and family routines."},{"type":"fact","content":"Paperless enrolment is active, but the member wants reassurance that any replacement card correspondence will also be sent electronically."},{"type":"observation","content":"The member was keen to finish quickly and may not have had time to review all settings, so a check of notification preferences would be sensible next time."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member liked a friendly, reassuring tone and found it helpful when the adviser summarised the remaining open items before ending the call."}]}
